metric: total detailed-routing wall time reduction versus stronger native/controlled FastPass baseline at fixed correctness and downstream guardrails
numeric_interval_status: Not estimable without representative baseline solving share, query incidence, signature count and local timings. No measured gains and no fabricated numerical forecast.

qualitative_scenarios.pessimistic: Compilation/state explosion or canonicalization overhead; fallback preserves correctness but loses latency.
qualitative_scenarios.base: Little whole-flow benefit because nativeSAT and small components already cheap; generic compilation reduction may defeat novelty.
qualitative_scenarios.optimistic: Some real components admit strong residual-state merging and enough actual queries to amortize construction, while whole-flow solving share remains material.

assumptions: Complete fixed finite pair-conflict graph and candidate domain.
Geometry and final witness matched in controlled arms.
Actual invocation/query count only; no artificial repeated demand.
Independent rule/connectivity oracle and three independent design families.
New allocation and P/C matching consent before execution.

screening_threshold_not_forecast.status: Proposer suggestion awaiting T02 practitioner/endpoint validation; not owner requirement.

analytic_interval.lower: May be negative with arbitrary compilation overhead, bounded only by enforced fallback resource cap.
analytic_interval.status: Symbolic conditional bound, no numerical interval.

calibration_plan: T05 records native fraction and seconds saved upper bound before candidate evaluation; T07 reports per-family paired timing, correctness, all censored cases and prediction errors. Deterministic repeats are not independent designs.
